name: io.github.Archaofan/xusbcan
title: xusbcan
description: Bench CAN for AI agents via CLI/MCP on python-can. Local stdio; user-supplied drivers.

environmentVariables.name: XUSBCAN_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to xusbcan.toml (device aliases). Required for real hardware.

environmentVariables.name: ZLG_SDK_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory with vendor ZLG SDK (zlgcan.dll). User-supplied; optional.

environmentVariables.name: CHUANGXIN_SDK_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory with Chuangxin ControlCAN.dll. User-supplied; optional.
